As the frame generation technology happens outside of the game engine, the in-game FPS or other third-party metrics may not report any boost to FPS.
AMD Software Performance Metrics can allow users to track the resulting FPS and the additional frame latency from AFMF.
AFMF introduces additional GPU overhead, which may result in a lower performance benefit if the game is GPU-bound.
image://icon64/image
AFMF may be tuned using the Advanced View or Custom experience for better image quality or smoothness.
For additional smoothness at high resolutions, the AFMF High-Resolution Search Mode can be enabled.
To reduce the overhead of AFMF for low-power devices, the Performance Mode may be used.
image://icon64/battery
As AFMF requires V-SYNC to be disabled, some users may see the game run at an uncapped FPS.
Users can limit the in-game FPS with Radeon
 Chill. Users with Variable Refresh Rate Monitors are recommended to set the Chill peak FPS to slightly less than half the maximum supported refresh rate.
To maintain a smooth experience, users can set the Idle and Peak FPS to a close value.

available here: <a href='http://www.google.com/policies/privacy'>http://www.google.com/policies/privacy</a>.<br>
                    To provide you with access to this Feature, AMD stores your YouTube access token locally on your machine for convenient access to YouTube API Services without the need to login every time a new session is created. AMD does not store or distribute any other data associated with YouTube API Services except for non-personalized usage statistics only when you are enrolled in the AMD User Experience program.<br>
                    You can revoke third-party account access using Google's security settings page
available here: <a href='https://security.google.com/settings/security/permissions'>https://security.google.com/settings/security/permissions</a>.<br>
                    If you have questions in relation AMD
s processing of your data in connection with the Feature, please direct your request to Privacy Request or contact privacy@amd.com for more information.  For more information about AMD
s privacy practices, please visit <a href='https://www.amd.com/en/corporate/privacy'>www.amd.com/en/corporate/privacy</a>.<br>
